text: Didn't keep in touch as much as I wanted and it took a while.But service was good and watch looks great

The process of dealing with Watchfinder was, as usual, fairly painless.The only issue was delivery of the watch where DHL claimed it had been delivered at 1130 when it hadn’t. (no usable POD provided by website of app) An email and call to Watchfinder resulted in zero assistance with finding where my watch actually was. It eventually arrived later that day. Still no follow up from Watchfinder about it.
The watch is beautiful but when paying that kind of money you would think the date and time would be set. Back to Timpsons this weekend as date is wrong again .
The worst service, they cancel me the orden, without any explanation.

I bought a Rolex 5500 watch, my jeweller adjusting the strap commented "not a Rolex " strap. Made in the u.s.a gave it away. The Rolex website insists all parts are sourced in Switzerland and nowhere else in the world.  Make up yr own mind.

I’m a bit disappointed this time around with watchfinder as I’ve purchased a couple of watches but this time around they didn’t ask me for my wrist size to adjust the strap for my wrist!!!Apart from that everything went smoothly!!!
First rate collection/delivery + quality watches. Only negative is part exchange value of watch previously bought from them.

Watchfinder had my watch for servicing, which took much longer than I was initially told, and then I had to chase them for updates, rather than them keeping in touch with me.  I would not say I felt this was a premium service based on the above - at this price point I would expect better.  I'm pleased with the overall look of the watch now I finally have it back, but not sure I would use them again based on the above.
Took too long to be returned

If you want a 5* review you’ll have to use a different carrier to DHL!!! Did their normal trick of saying they’d tried to deliver but nobody at home. Have video evidence to prove this a lie!!! Wasted an afternoon awaiting delivery and made alternatve arrangements to collect children from school. No idea what watch looks like as haven’t received it yet.

Overjoyed with my watch, but on receiving it I found out that it was much older than I was led to believe, I was not happy with this as I had to find out for myself. the issue was resolved quickly and I was happy with the result

Hit and miss pricing, poor QC. Preferential pricing. Their offers for watches are most the time insulting. My friend and I submitted the same watch 1 month apart, he got offered 1.5k more for his than me. Same age condition etc only different coloured dial. That being said I once got a reasonable offer on a Blancpain I traded in that went through smoothly.I asked to view a 15k watch. I liked it. I offered 14k for it, watchfinder said no only to have it on sale for that much 2 months later ☺️.Their warranties are none transferable and also pretty worthless. I sent in a Zenith chronograph for a movement service as its amplitude was shocking (I can't believe they sold it like that in the first place). The watch came back with a subdial that wouldn't reset.

Exchanged my watch for another purchase with Watchfinder. Great despatch and delivery to collect my watch and send out pre owned. Mine went back with registration card, booklets, links and tag. Disappointed that purchase came back with only the card in the box. This withheld additional information would have helped with my choice rather than just "box & papers". Got a good deal overall I think.
You are highly efficient but you always quote a price & then find a reason to reduce it in the final offer. Your staff deserve five stars, your price chipping spoils your service.

The watch is as described but the delivery was less so. Ordered on the 13th December with a "guaranteed Christmas delivery", their words not mine. Unfortunately Watchfinder did not despatch until the 22nd December, DHL could not turn it around in less than a day and so delivery of a Christmas present was not achieved until the 27th December. Watchfinder have blamed the original supplier and DHL but they were the ones providing a guaranteed Christmas delivery.Disappointed with the response from Watchfinder.
Links to my watch were not sent and then I am told they didn’t have them ?

The model type was not correct however this was positive in my favour and the paperwork was corrected.Still need to resolve a small issue with the bracelet.However there are real people on the phone and they did assist the purchase.

The general experience was good however, an email confirmed someone would contact me to discuss and arrange delivery.  This never happened, I got an email just saying the watch is on it's way without confirming my delivery address.  I wanted to change my delivery address from my billing address as the watch was a present and I didn't want my partner to receive the parcel.

buying the watch was very easy but when i was informed that the delivery address was incorrect my heart sank ... As this was my first experience with Watchfinder i was worried but i called customer services & they said they would sort it & they did but i wasnt made aware it was all being ok till i heard from the courier ...
everything was fine but the watch was not adjusted to my wrist size , which I e mailed to you.I was unable to wear the watch until it was adjusted.Which was disappointing.

The company did exactly what is required. They supplied a watch. The quality control is lacking and so is the description. One of the links of my Breitling navitimer were installed the wrong way round (most likely the original owner). This should have been identified in quality control as it's not exactly hard to spot as there is a long side and a short side.Also the description lacked any mention that the watch would not come with spare links (most likely the previous owner again). This should have been mentioned.
Watch was stunning but strap had been cut so have to buy a new strap which wasn’t told about in the advert not end of the world but just a cost on top of watch
I ordered a Rolex Daytona, it arrived scratched. They have agreed to sort it but obviously disappointing and an inconvenience to me.

Well I ordered a very expensive watch I phone them up, to put it on hold as I was unable to give them the wrist measurements,  however it got dispatched and it did arrive in great time but obviously it was too small. It is a 21st birthday present and I had to phone them to ask what was going on the lady I spoke to was very nice and apologetic and she send they will find the extra links and I was able to take it to any jewller and they would pay for it.  However I have still not received the links and I had to phone up again, and they said they were trying to get them but the thing is I have not been informed of any other progress and this was two weeks ago so I will have to phone them up again.

THIS WOULD HAVE BEEN 5 STARS BUT THE RETURN PACKAGEING WAS NOT GREAT THE WATCH WAS ROLLED UP IN SOFT PLASTIC AND IN A SEALED PLASTIC BAG ROLLING ABOUT IN THE CARDBOARD BOX NOT IN THE PREFORMED FOAM LINING OF THE BOX IT WAS SENT IN WHICH WATCHFINDER SENT ME ORIGINALLY FOR DISPATCH.

Initial purchasing service was good; as quick & slick as I'd hoped for. Plus safe & discreet shipping & packaging. Watch itself is also in the excellent condition I expected.Left with a bad taste though when I tried to register the watch with the manufacturer and it wasn't clear if the watch was authentic. Aside from getting it fully appraised at dealer, I'm comfortable it is authentic, but Watchfinder didn't seem to care when I questioned this. They just asked me to speak directly to the manufacturer, and offered literally nothing by way of reassurance or additional info about the watch's authenticity. Won't purchase again from WF in a hurry, and will factor in getting it checked by dealer if I ever do.

I ordered 2 watches on line and followed up with a call to discuss delivery giving a full week advanced notice to ensure delivery on a specific date. The WatchFinder Agent confirmed that this would be more than adequate to guarantee delivery as requested. The delivery was late by 3 days which was very annoying as one item was for a retirement present. Spoke to the Agent on the day of delivery after the courier messaged that delivery would be the following week. Provided all details to Agent and then put on hold. Finally put through to Briony who confirmed she would investigate and advise. Haven’t had any update/ explanation. Don’t advertise a next day service if you have no intention of completing this even with advance notice. Very disappointed - unlikely to use WatchFinder again purely for this level of service.

The watch as described and in immaculate condition.However, one to be cautious about when Watchfinder use a “stock image” when the watch isn’t available or not ready to purchase.You’d think the stock image would be at minimum expectation the same colour scheme as the actual watch for sale. In my case, not the same colour scheme. In the description it did not state the correct colour of watch.This is, in my opinion a lack of attention to detail and obviously in this case standards had slackened.

Pleased to have got this one. A fantastic santos 100 in exemplary condition as usual from Watchfinder. Unfortunately due to their derisory offers on Rolex’s I’ve purchased from them(other traders offered over 10%more) I’m going to have to look elsewhere in future.
Slightly too overpriced and not willing to sell.

Service was excellent and helpful thought out. Update on the status of item was frequent. Would one hundred percent, trust again to have work completed.Reason for 3 stars, that trade in prices weren’t expected to be SO low. Even after having the item serviced including box and papers.Good experience and would recommend to someone.

This is my 3rd purchase from Watchfinder. First two were really good , this one has been awful.Ordered a watch from them back in early June , watch had significant damage to the crown guard and bezel so I returned it and ordered a different watch.Was told the watch would take 4-5 days , ended up taking over 2 weeks.The watch arrived with a sizeable scratch on the case , after I was told the delay was due to QA......The strap fitted was also way too small , no idea how any human adult could get the watch on.Sent the watch back for repair and for a new strap , was told this would take 2/3  weeks.This time has now come and gone and I still don't have the watch.I have had no updates at all other than when I have chased them , despite promises to keep me informed of what is going on.Multiple emails have gone unanswered and they haven't called me back when they said they would.Main difference I can see is this sale was arranged by  one of the staff at the Birmingham branch , all the  others were done by staff at the head office and were excellent , both in keeping me updated and in the standard of the watches.Moral of the story , don't order a watch at the weekend from Watchfinder when the head office aren't in.UPDATE 10/08/2023Still don't have the watch 2 months after ordering it , I'm basically being ghosted by WF now , emails going unanswered , virtually impossible to get through to them on the phone.Update 21/09Finally got the watch through from WF but there was an issue with the auto winding, exxchanged it for another watch of the same model and finally have a working watch, got there in the end.Rachel and Luke were a massive help getting this deal finally done . thanks

Slow and disappointing, but got there.I got an estimate from WF to buy my watch, which had a price range.So considering my watch was in new condition, was a complete set, was unworn and still had all original stickers. I believed I would get something near the higher end of their estimate. Therefore, I sent them my watch visiting one of their stores (19th May)It then took until the 19th June to get an offer which was bottom price of the range. So I refused the offer and wondered what it would have taken to get the higher end.WF then returned the watch to me. However, during their inspection; they removed the original factory stickers and damaged the rear of the watch.Then after a lot of communication WF agreed to take the watch back and offer me the higher end of their  original offer.Today is the 26th July. So it has taken over 2 months for me to sell this one watch.I appreciate the online process and platform is good; and I am sure most people do not have the same issues as me.However, based on my personal experience I can’t justify 5 stars as I was let down several times and left chasing for my result.

I purchased two watches and received excellent service by sales team as well as aftersales team. However the overall experience was let down due to quality control issues.One of the watches I received had issues and it had to be sent back to manufacturer for repair via watchfinder (it takes 25 to 30 days to assess the issue and then manufacturer will give the timeline for repair). I dont think I will receive the watch back before 2 to 3 months at least.My expectation was that the watch will be delivered to me in workng order (in fact they send a letter stating that it has gone through extensive testing before being delivered). I appricaite that aftersales team has been very helpful in arranging warranty repair but it doesnt take away from the fact that the watch was not tested properly before being sold (one of the main reason for purchasing from watchfinder for me is their quality control).Anyways, I have no choice but to wait. Again excellent service by the sales team and after sales team but overall expereince is let down due to quality control (buying a new watch and then waiting for 2/3 months for the repair to complete which should have been completed before watch being sold is not a great experience).
Lake of communication and I keep losing my time after spending almost 40K.
I thought it was okay lack of information when it came to finding out when the watch was coming ! Other than that fine

Sales team were great, however the after sales were found to be wanting. I spent over 10k on the space of a few days and even after countless emails/calls I couldn’t get confirmation of when the watches would arrive. I’ve been abroad so naturally I didn’t want the items left by the front door and wanted both watches to turn up together. I don’t know if they’re just super busy but some confirmation would have been ideal instead of stress.
Generally good experience but trouble with delivery and collection

This was the second time I used Watchfinders. The first time was an excellent experience. This time, however it was quite so good. Firstly I part exchanged a watch, and I was surprised to be told that it needed a repair.  I had not noticed anything untoward on the watch. I had had it two years, and had not worn it very much. However they did half the cost of the repairs for me, and I was not in a position to question the assessment. The second issue was the person assisting me forgot to  e mail me with the offer, because he had been on a day off.Both these issues held up what should have been a smooth process, and were a little disappointing. I would however use them again, as the selection of watches is mind boggling!!

Great watch we'll presented and priced, and Hani was helpful at every stage.Two things consistently let this company down though.1. Purchasing dept is way too slow in ascertaining px values, and2. DHL are rubbish and won't specify an hourly window like dpd, so you are left waiting around all day for deliveries.Steven Kennedy

First let me start by stating that I am perfectly happy with the watch I purchased and experience at Royal exchange store however the process leading up to the sale was very painful. I had to make several calls top get help and unfortunately Brandon no fault of his own could provide the necessary information or ask the manager how to deal with me. This was disappointing considering that this is my 4th purchase. Once I got to Richard things moved rather smoothly and I hope my next purchase will not be like a visit to the dentist.

Rather disappointing so far.Watch delivered on time but it was immediately apparent that the bracelet was faulty as it fell to pieces before my wife could even put it on her wrist!Not the ideal birthday gift.Customer service was apologetic and responsive saying that if we could return the watch to the nearest store the necessary repair could be performed and an appointment was confirmedWe then spent half a day travelling into central London where upon arrival we were politely received but it was also apparent that we were not expected.A brief inquiry however showed that the spare part had arrived and the repair could be undertaken as we waited.Alas after 15 minutes we were informed that the replacement part was incorrect !We left the ill fated watch together with all its packaging and await further news.
I returned watch as the original box was in a very poor condition. The watch is now re - listed on their site for £1,ooo more 🤔😳

The watch I purchased had to be returned to your company as it was not fit for purpose. I was very disappointed with your customer service department’s initial response to the problem. However I would like to thank  your colleague Mustafa who dealt with this unfortunate situation very professionally. I am now more than happy with the watch which has been repaired and returned to me.
The buying of the watch was excellent, How ever the delivery explained and courier used was very stressful.
Watch was broken, its sti with you niw getting fixed
Was disappointed when I received my watch that the day date had not been set.

Everything was excellent until I returned the watch - I had to arrange own insured courier and DhL only insure up to 4K - so advice is to agree in advance for Watchfinder to arrange collection if you need to return after viewing otherwise you will be paying another £100 out of own pocket - not ideal

The transaction which consisted of part exchanging my previous watch generally was satisfactory. However for a luxury purchase I was disappointed that despite a phone call and email regarding my desired length of the bracelet, this was not done. This resulted in a 80 mile round trip to the Lakeside store to collect and have the link fitted. They did offer to send it in the post but I do not trust changing links myself. Also there was scratches behind the lugs which was not polished out.However the watch was purchased at a reasonable price from a trusted retailer which is why I am happy to keep and not return
Easy to navigate through website, but contact after placing order wasn't very forthcoming; didn't hear anything about dispatch for a week

Good Points - Raymond Weil Freelancer Chronograph was a great price and aesthetically excellent, looked to be unworn. All boxes in good condition with original sales invoice from USA. Initially reacted very quickly to my complaint, sending me an express DHL package to send it back the same day. Excellent Price.Not So Good Points - Watchfinder claim all watches are tested for accuracy, amongst other things. This clearly wasn't the case with my watch as it gained 1 hour in the first 12 hours after setting the time. Turnaround was a month to repair it which I thought was too long. The original listing didn't state the watch was in the USA but it did arrive in about a week.Verdict: I'd use them again but a similar second experience would deter me from buying a third time.
Can’t fault what I bought from them and the price was ok. Even got a little discount aswell but the overall buying experience wasn’t what I would of expected paying what I did.

Bit of a mixed experience really, the watch I was buying was a Xmas present I ordered at the very start of dec only to find out it was not available before Xmas until a week before. Anyway I was offered an alternative which was great but this was only after a laboured time trying to get replies from customer service and also awkward phone calls which I’d asked not to be called as it was a surprise!I eventually picked up in store and they were very helpful, so a mixed experience which ended well. The watch was all it should be at a fair price though.

When told we would be overseas and could not take delivery until Monday this week, it was very disappointing to find that delivery had been made on Friday last week!! Fortunately, someone was here to receive it purely by chance. This was not good on the part of watchfinder.
I ordered a watch early Sept, and was left guessing what had happened to my order for 3 months, very poor communication. The final resolution was fine, in mid December.
Had a bad experience but eventually got resolved…
Strap was to be adjusted and this never happened. Additional costs now to get the strap altered plus wasted time

I have used Watchfinder three times now over the last 6 years or so for servicing my Omega. The first two transactions were quick, efficient and professional. Unfortunately, my last experience was not so good, largely due to the fact that it took 3 months for a simple service where previously it was around a third of this time. I am advised that this is because post Brexit rules mean Watchfinder have to use a different courier system which essentially adds 2 months to the process creating an almost unacceptable delay to the whole operation. I will look to find a more local agent for my next service, albeit this may be impossible.

Bought a watch two weeks ago, Omega Seamaster.The day after I bought it I had the only call I've had, saying the watch was in Paris and it would be 3-4 days until it would be in the UK and I'd be notified when it was due for dispatch. I said no problem. The time passed and I heard nothing. I emailed several times, then rang, initially no one ever answering the phones, and when I did get someone they said the watch would be in the UK the following week and the watch was still in France. I expressed some exasperation that no one was keeping me in the loop in any way. It's now nearly two weeks since I bought the watch and I'm still waiting for it. I have no option now but will be asking for a full refund if I'm not satisfied in a day or two.I've had at no time someone from the company contacting me apart from when I've had to do the chasing. I've written 6 emails, not a single reply. Have rung at least 8-10 times, left multiple messages and been promised callbacks from management that have never come.This is the third or fourth watch I've had from this company and have previously received excellent service. This time it's been truly awful and I will as a result never use this company again and will actively condemn it to anyone buying a watch.Update 16/11/22. My watch is apparently stuck in customs for some reason but it was only when one of the managers Mark got involved that anything was remedied. He offered a refund or to send out a duplicate watch immediately, one that was a year younger than the one I ordered (which I chose). It took a little over two weeks for me to receive anything from the original order and was a frustrating experience with a total lack of communication- but Mark did try and put things right. I've raised my star from one to three, but would still be hesitant to use them again.
For a service it took approx 6 weeks, which is far too long in my opinion.

The DHL man who called me before he arrived treated me with more respect calling me Sir and telling me to have a good day.This is my first expensive watch and Harry on the phone didn’t really show or recognise the importance of the purchase, when I call Amex they are super polite and don’t try and argue the point like Harry did when he suggested I travel over 30miles to Brentwood to sort this issue even though it wasn’t my fault.When the watch arrived it was just loose in the box which wasn’t what I would of expected opening the box for the first time.

I would suggest seeing the watch in person before buying. Limited photos. I asked the sales representative about possible marks on the glass but was told (in writing) that their condition notes do not mention any marks. There are indeed marks on the crystal even though small.Secondly the watch arrived unsized despite providing the wrist measurement. Had a call before dispatch and the assistant confirmed that the watch had been resized. So neutral rating.

Staff in the store were completely uninterested, almost like it was a chore to bother them.Service online was great, easy to purchase plus answered any questions I had. I am a repeat customer and have always been very happy with the service offered. For an expensive item and from a company that considers themselves luxury, I expected a lot  better on this occasion!
I bought a watch for my husband & when it was delivered it wasn’t working, surely you would have checked it was working before it was delivered, I won’t be using Watchfinder again

Not all that happy with my the level of restriction you put in place retarding dilvery, I'm a single person and I'm out working 6days a week ,so I've found it hard to even receive the watch,witch I haven't yet ,normally I would travel to the depo myself after work ,witch has never been a problem for me with any of my purchases made before, I've managed to have my house sit for me to take dilvery next week ,and they can't even give me a time of day ,only on the day of dilvery, so I'm a bit disappointed that I doint even have the watch yet ,when I rang DHL the evening they tried to dilvery, to see if I could come and collect it they said no I can't, witch I think is a bit over the top

Ok...  since the original, they follow up well, made the strap the correct size and sent back in a reasonable time.   That said, there is still quite a bit of up-sell in the process.   I may or may not use them for any Watch cleaning, maintenance or purchases in the future.  I won't say 'no', but I will think twice.I sent my watch in with a simple broken pin in the strap.All the strap parts were there.   I agreed to a £400+ piece of work for general cleaning, maintainence, etc...While the work looks good, my watch was sent back too small.  Simply doesn't fit.  I would fully expect that you would simply measure the size the watch... do the work..  and ensure it is the same size when you return it.

Bought a Panerai PAM00200 advertised with box and papers.  When it arrived the pin buckle had been fitted incorrectly.  The box contained user manual and a service booklet.  The watch dates back to 2006.  Panerai recommend service interval at between 2 and 5 years.  There was no evidence of the watch ever having had a service.  This information should be contained in the description of the watch. Watchfinder in my view have an obligation to obtain the history of the watch from panerai if it is not present at point of purchase.  Panerai now want 330 euros to verify the watch and provide me with the history.  As I paid £11000 for the the watch, this information should be included by watchfinder.  Very disappointing.

The product is beautiful, exactly as described. The customer service and communication was very poor.It’s a tricky one because the watch is lovely and I’ve used this company before. Sometimes the lasting memory is the comms and the warm feeling (or not) that you get when you part with your hard earned.
Delivery set up is not good and if your buying on finance it's doubly not good - a bit of stigma attached perhaps ?
Staff were very helpful but service from Breitling was awful watch was away for nearly 6 months ,terrible !!!

The watch was delivered to me with a problem, it will need to be returned to Watchfinder. It indicates that the watch was not fully checked over before despatch. In other regards, the service was as good as usual.

still waiting for the watch.used you before and was great, this time DHL have done nothing but fail to deliver and LIE. and worse still said I had lied which is not good as they are Representing Watchfinder I have taken a day off work today 14th April at a cost of £425, makes me look at other watch dealersYOU NEED TO CHANGE YOUR COURIER SERVICE

I purchased a Tag Heuer Carrera from Watchfinder, the order and delivery process was excellent as was the watch when i opened it. The watch was faultless, the box on the other hand was in an appalling state, this had not been shown in the pictures or revealed in the description. I immediately contacted customer support who responded straight away asking for pictures and the dimensions of the box they could source a replacement. The information was sent straight away but despite contacting them on more than one occasion they have failed to replace the damaged box or even respond to e-mails.

Ordered my watch which they shipped from the hong kong boutique that was all good the watch is brilliant but dont think the face too face service is all that good one member of staff id say snobby/snotty the other who served uninterested and didnt really say much felt like it was more of a chore been treated better in other watch dealers woud use again just maybe not leeds branch

Watchfinder were excellent in arranging the sale of the watch. I would go as far to give them 5 star. Ordered the watch on the Wednesday and it was delivered to me by Thursday morning. However the aftercare is shoddy to say the least. The watch arrived to my house 2 links short, so requested 2 more links. I was bounced around from one sales representative to another after care sales team. Links have still not arrived 4 days after being told they had been sent. I have chased the links and received a blunt (borderline rude) email to say they had been posted. No one seems to care once they have made the sale.

Please let the stars above reflect my dealings, of which are many. They are watch dealing acting as some kind of deity. Would not bother again. That said, they do not bother to contact you back, save for this generic email, requesting me to review my recent purchase of which was a few years ago.
Good as usual in many respects, but watch was delivered with bracelet far too long after I had given Watchfinder my wrist measurements.

The transaction was very easy and the Watchfinder staff friendly and helpful, but a problem with the courier transformed the transaction for me.  The courier is supposed to deliver by 1pm but the delivery arrived at 3.45pm because the instructions given were wrong.

I am very pleased with the watch I bought and the service from the staff I spoke to. The reason I dropped two stars was that yesterday I recieved my phone bill and saw that Watchfinder "SALES" line is a premium line and it cost me over £3 for a quick call to descuss the watch before purchase. I know I should have seen this before I made the call but I didn't!

The service and advice from Tom was excellent. However, the very poor quality of switchboard, not answering the phone ,poor diction, length of time kept waiting made me doubt the authenticity of the company.I even traveled to London to collect my purchase to establish they existed it was so poorly fronted.The shop staff in the City were great, very helpful and knowledgable and the premises impressive.Get the first impression right and you will have a great business !

5 stars on the watchfinder side of things but poor delivery. The delivery driver tried to steal the package claiming he had knocked but the 3 people in the house at the time has hear nothing. However as a company Andrei has really held up their reputation. From the initial phone call to enquiring about the watch to delivering it he has been helpful all the way through. Thanks Andrei from Lakeside.

The initial process was efficient. However, although I gave my wrist size twice - once on the order site and once in an email - when the watch arrived no links had been removed.  I had to take the watch in to a local jewellers where the work was done at a cost of £35.  I emailed Watchfinder to point this out well over a week ago but at the time of writing I have not received any response.

Unfortunately the paperwork  was lost on my purchase , I bought the watch with box and paper work and only the box turned up , the watch was 52k with no paper work it’s worth 20% less , we are given the company until the end of January to come up with the paper work but it is not looking good .

Great product, well packaged etc... but delivered in error by DHL to a neighbour, - proof of delivery photo showed their doormat (and legs) not mine. Given that this was a £1,700 order, I was less than impressed. Recommend you consider using DPD instead, much more reliable and secure.
Generally good service however disappointed with the delay in delivery service.Thanks

The sales process was good but delivery of my new watch was shocking.  I waited in all weekend for a delivery that did not arrive.  The tracking website did not work.  This caused me to miss family events over the weekend.  The watch finally arrived two days later than promised and disrupted my working week.
Quoted an acceptable value to buy from me, then hammered me down and down.

It took me a while to get a response from someone at Watchfinder on the first and second try. I'm not sure why, maybe they thought I was some fly by night character yanking their chain.After an initial response, the person I was in touch with didn't reply back and I sent up two follow-up emails directly, and I didn't get any response from that either.To cut a long story short, I just ended up buying a piece I wanted without going for a part exchange, as I was worried someone else might purchase it. I felt it went smoothly after that, felt a bit like it was only because a direct purchase was on hand.Buying with Watchfinder was an okay experience, my rating would be higher if I didn't get given the run around early on, its only 3 stars because I felt after being ghosted, they really stepped up to the plate with everything else when it came to a purchase. Everything is as advertised, item came in quick and insured, and I really appreciate that as I'm on the other side of the planet.Might wait a while to give it another go.
Not very responsive once order was placed.Had to chase delivery 3 times.
Everything was fine, apart from the fact the my watch would be delivered on a particular day. A family member stayed in the whole day and it didn’t arrive

Generally very good experience. Prompt and slick.My issue is that the watch I purchased was advertised as 2006 but when I received it the original receipt was dated 2002.Watchfinder refused to acknowledge their misrepresentation of the age.

The experience of actually buying my watch was great , however the delivery process was a different story , delivery was 2 days later than first promised and while this could be seen as the carriers fault it was also impossible to get a call through to Watchfinder I called 5 or 6 times over the two days and failed to get through to anyone and there is no facility to leave a message ! I then resorted to the on line chat , and just got automated responses ! Frankly just not good enough!

The watch appears to be serviced / polished to a good standard by Panerai. I was not made aware that the watch would need to go to Panerai until after it was left with Watchfinder. The whole process took FAR longer than I was expecting (8 weeks). My wife was made to wait for an unreasonable length of time at the Leeds branch when dropping-off the watch, despite having an appointment. Overall I'd give 3.5 stars - more than average but less than great.

Have dealt with a number times in the past and usually very good.  Latest experience is turning into a bit of a nightmare though.  Returned an item for refund which reached their returns address on the 8 October.  As at the 22 October still waiting for the refund despite the timescales being stated as 5 working days. Poor communication once they were in receipt of my timepiece and insist that a BACS transfer takes 3 to 5 working days, which in todays world of banking is unacceptable.

Hence I now have a £450 service bill for my Breitling Avenger Seawolf that I purchased 18 months ago!Try asking if your prospective purchase has been serviced and you will probably be told, as I was, 'Oh yes sir, all our watches are fully inspected and any work needed is completed before we sell'. As far as I can tell, my watch has never been serviced since new - 2006! As always, buyer beware and negotiate a discount to cover at least some of the cost of a service!Response to your reply.Apologies, my mistake, the watch was purchased just over 2 years ago. However, having read your reply which repeats your company statement, I would say that merely running a watch through a timing machine is not enough to give a true impression of it's health, as my experience seems to prove. Your sales statement says that everything is done to the watches that they require, prior to sale. The truth is that you sold me a watch that had not been serviced for over 10 years when Breitling recommend a full service every 4-6 years, and therefore it was not prepared to Breitling standards but to Watchfinder's which appear to be considerably lower. Because of this, I now have a £450 bill for servicing after 2 years of ownership instead of the 4-6 years I was expecting!

Great service from Sean, but let down by Charlie in customer services/aftersales over a link that, in reality, should have been supplied with the watch (it would have been if bought retail).In a nutshell, I was asked what size to put the strap prior to sending, I advised 7.5ins. The reality was that this was just slightly too tight. When I enquiries why additional links weren’t in the box I was told I’d have to buy them. This was eventually resolved, it’s not what you want when you’ve just spent almost £9k on a timepiece.

Face to face with Oliver was good but the assessment of my part exchange took too long and the handover of the watch from someone else ( no name given) was rude . The greeting was “ Have you got an appointment “ . No hello, very off hand and arrogant . No thank you , no goodbye. People like that shouldn’t be allowed out of the back office.
Disjointed customer service. I was dealt with by 4 different advisors over the course of a purchase - none of whom knew what the other one had done previously.

when I arrived to collect my new watch I was kept waiting for around 15 minutes. I appreciate that all the desks were taken up with people browsing but I was actually there to collect a watch I had paid for.The other people all left without purchasing which made it even more frustrating. I felt like I was expected to wait whilst people asked to try on watch after watch with no intention of buying.My suggestion would be to get one more desk and keep two for pre-booked appointments and the others for walk in customers. You will then not have to keep genuine customer waiting.

Great service from salesperson ( TY Ed. ) However passing the so called security to prevent fraud a real pain in the A+++. After paying the deposit and passing 3d security, still had to verify where i worked??? Why the finance company had already done this. Great products good prices but not sure i would use them again

Me and my boyfriend was excited obviously as we were going to purchase a watch. The lady who served us was friendly and professional. But when going to put the finance through she didn’t really know how to do it. And when she asked help of her colleague. Her colleague seemed to mock her in a way. Laughing at her saying she should know. She asked for help the whole time. There’s nothing wrong with this. Luckily the shop was quite. If it was busy I don’t think the colleagues would of been able to help. Overall the experience was okay. We came away with the watch and we were very happy

My watch arrived swiftly but unfortunately was running fast and the date was misaligned. Once I reported the fault the watch was fixed over a 10 day period and returned in excellent condition.Prompt service, disappointed for a watch to be delivered in that condition.
The watch came in good time, but with no links? So doesn’t fit and now have to wait another 3 days for the links.
felt uncomfortable sending all funds to 'secure' a viewing but in the end all panned out fine.

I bought a watch, £3250 which was advertised as next day delivery. A few days later I got an email from my customer services contact who was going to look after me and ensure I got my watch. Who then went on holiday without letting me know or passing control to someone else. I had to email chase delivery, but it did eventually arrive.

Great friendly service , but was a bit disappointed by the sense of generosity given. I bought a 20K watch and asked for an extra bracelet link ( worth around 150 £ ) and was not given that.Considering that I have been a regular guest for many years I was a bit surprised . I paid outright for the watch , I would have understood if I would have gone for finance .

Staff were friendly.but the shop itself is small and has no seating or desk area to go through the buying of your watch.your standing up leaning over trying to fill in all your details on a laptop,with other customers waiting as your there trying to fill in all your personal information.now in most cases your are spending a lot of money and I feel the lack of seating area to compleate the buying of your watch isn’t a good thing at all.somewhat unprofessional.

I understand that £5000 to purchase a watch is common place, however to me its a lot of money, hence it would have been more enjoyable if your representative had more empathy and less aggression. I felt I was interfering in his day at work.
Head office great, shop not so

The watch I received is very nice, I am pleased with my purchase.Just one problem though, when I unpacked the watch box I found is was just lying loose in the watch box and not on the supplied pillow, this meant the watch was free to just tumble around inside during the postage to me. I do not see any damage to the exterior, but?I did contact Watchfinder with an email and photos but they did not bother to even reply. This is no way to treat an expensive watch and no way to treat a customer.
Watch great and arrived as scheduled but bracelet links missing. Sent subsequently but I shouldn't have had to query.
Bit disappointed that the watch wasn’t fully working after it had a full service.
I’ve used quite a few of your branches but your Brent X branch is still very much in its infant stage and it really shows. I won’t use this particular branch again.

Got an offer via email on a watch that was reasonable, and so was invited to pop in to their London "purchasing office" in the prestigious Burlington Arcade, so they could inspect the watch to seal the deal. I subsequently did so, and it was remarkable at how incongruous the service I was greeted with was, in the context of the luxury market these guys are looking to serve.I can't remember the name of the chap I was dealing with, and wouldn't name names even if I could, however I can tell you that no respect for the timepiece was made (this is a £16k+ retail watch, mind you; not chump change, at least to me!); box and papers treated roughly in front of me, handling of the watch was abrupt and disconcerting (relative to how I would/do, and I treat other's possessions even more carefully than my own so expect the same when someone else is handling my property), no gloves or such being worn when handling the watch (just a small thing, but if you want to be professional...), and returning it with time and date changed from what it was when I handed it over; I found it all incredibly odd.Beyond this, and I can assure you I'm not a paranoid snowflake(!), I was genuinely worried when he was looking at it under the light/magnification (back at his desk a little away from the seating area, though I could hear and observe through the holes in the divider), on account of his fumbling, knocking items around on his desk and onto the floor, all the while handling my expensive timepiece.Whilst no one thing may be particularly egregious, the litany of small transgressions rendered an overwhelmingly unprofessional feeling, and one I was happy to have gotten out of with my watch thankfully unscathed.Icing on the cake was that the fellow came back having affirmed the quality and condition of the watch after inspection, yet indicated that he'd still need to send it off to the main office for a final offer (5 working days and shipping it to another part of the country), despite the very fact I personally popped in explicitly to avoid the need for this and to receive an immediate offer.My advice wouldn't necessarily be to stay away from WF&Co in total, but if you do decide to chance a Burlington Arcade visit to sell a watch, communicate clearly your expectations around how your timepiece is handled, and keep it within sight at all times! But really, if my experience is anything close to normal, it's probably worth just sending it to their main office rather than faffing around with the amateurs in their London 'purchasing but I'm not really given any actual authority to make a purchasing decision' office.. that is, if you're willing to put your timepiece in the post and have it separated from you without a firm offer or guarantee of superlative handling/insurance whilst in their possession for potentially weeks. (I wasn't.)

The release documents arrived with the wrong name and transaction number on them, which we had to edit. Also the documents emailed back were in your employees spam box, which he failed to detect. This is the third occasion we have had dealings with your company and this last experience was not satisfactory.

Varied experience. Phone call discussing watch choice with Scott was great. Although shop manner from Avery Row when picking up the watch from sales assistant was very poor. He explained how I inconvenienced him by not giving all the details while I was in the process of buying a £15k watch. I would’ve guessed as I’d bought the watch online all my details and notes would’ve been on file. His attitude definitely tainted the experience.

Overall happy with watchfinder just a little annoyed at Luke Johnston . The watch i received was in perfect condition apart form the bracelet was way too small. After taling to the sales rep Kevin i was dealing with he told me that he would get some links sent out. Along came Luke Johnston and said he would only send two links and anymore would be chargeable! When i questioned it he threw the terms and conditions email at me basically saying its a used watch so tuff luck mate! Now bare in mind it was a used Onega seamaster literally a few hundred less than new retail. I could have bought brand new, full bracelet with a discount for the same or less. Only my part ex of a mint rolex stopped me butikg new My only suggestion to users of this website is read all the terms and if selling take your spare links out (especially if a rolex like mine)  and sell them elsewhere. Seems they have no regard for this when selling to you!
Didn’t no that it would cost me 37 pounds to send a watch back though that was not fair
It was an ok experience. I feel regarding the selling of watches no matter how good the condition, how much original paperwork you have, you will always be offered the lower value.

My previous experiences of buying from Watchfinder have been faultless but my recent purchase has cast doubt on the thoroughness of the inspection they carry out on pre owned watches. The issue with my new watch was a poorly fitting clasp on its strap which came undone far too easily causing the watch to nearly fall off twice during the first days wear.Watchfinder arranged for the return and repair of the watch clasp in a very fast and efficient manner and I am now very pleased with my purchase. I do however feel that the clasp problem should have been identified and rectified before they chose to market the watch.

Efficient service, sold them my bretling. However, they always offer a price range. In my case it was £1400-1600. I sent the watch and they offered £1400 despite the watch being in immaculate condition with no justification.I paid nearly £2500 for the watch just one year earlier, so this was disappointing but the overall service was good.

I was contacted to ask about my wrist size, which I provided.  Sadly the watch had not been sized when it arrived so I now have to visit a local watch shop to have this done, and no doubt incur charges.Watchfinder have replied to say the watch was already at the size I had requested. This is categorically not true - why would I waste my time writing a review?  I had to remove two links to make it fit.  A simple apology would suffice
The watch is fantatic! The sale was top! The payment was a disappointment! Security is ok but the exciting was gone.

I bought an Omega through WF and on the whole the experience was positive.Initially though I had no contact from them, no confirmation order email, no receipt of purchase or anything detailing a delivery date. I waited a full 24 hours to before I contacted the call centre myself and requested a receipt.Having spent a significant sum of money my assumption was that this was the least that would happen. And it may be that my expectations aren’t in line with WF’s service, but my above observation seems like an easy win to give the customer a great experience.Once I had got past the initial ‘glitch’ the service thereafter was excellent and I was able to collect my watch earlier than expected. The lady in the Canary Wharf store was excellent and on the whole I had a good experience.
Great to deal with, very helpful, easy to buy from - but watch had to be returned due to an issue - dealt with under manufacturers warranty -  and it took over 3 weeks to get the watch back.

Great service from in store and online however within 10 minutes of the watch being delivered there was considerable condensation on the back of the glass.  The watch had to be taken back and sent to the service center within a day of me owning it.  It has all be dealt with well and they apologized but ultimately if you pay 3k for something you expect if to be perfect from day 1.

The customer service was good! The response was quick and very helpful. The delivery was late but I was informed about this which was very helpful. However I was left slightly deflated when my watch arrived. I felt it was dirty, between the links in the bracelet especially, which I wasn’t happy about. There wasn’t much description on the box just that it was original. It’s defiantly original but it’s not in the greatest condition which would have been nice to know about. If I’m completely honest I’m still not sure weather I want to keep the watch based on the box and the general condition of the watch.

Purchasing something could not be easier but picking up goods from this company’s shop needs improvement because the online purchasing experience is not quite matched in this company’s shops.  I would, however, commend its call centre staff for their work in sorting out a few gitches with my overall purchasing experience.

The result was great, securing the watch I wanted, but getting there not as smooth as it might have been.Having made an appointment to view the watch, this proved to be a wasted journey as it hadn’t been shipped to the agreed store.  After much apologising, a second appointment was made for later that week requiring a second visit, which proved successful.Having decided to proceed with the purchase, arrangements for collection were being made.  After several unanswered emails from me to try and finalise this, I phoned only to find out that a collection appointment had been made but that I had not been advised of this.Overall, everyone was very polite and I ended up with the watch I wanted.  Communication and organisation weren’t strong, however.This wouldn’t prevent me from engaging with Watchfinder again, but is simply a word of caution.

Initially good to get to agreed sale price but I had to chase and chase to eventually get everything sorted. Did not call back when they said they would which was frustrating when spending this type of money. Expected better.

The service during the purchase was friendly and professional however the watch stopped just aftera few days. I sent few emails and called the customer support but received little or no assistance, I therefore decided to take it to a same brand shop were it had a full service being carried out. I don't see much point in watchfinder offering a warranty if the watch is sold without being serviced.

This was a replacement from a returned watch that had an issue. Watchfinder replaced the watch no problem which was good. I had the original watch bracelet made to 21cm to fit my wrist. I made sure twice verbally that the replacement would be the same size @ 21cm. Upon arrival it was not sized and too small. Very frustrating spoke to customer services who sent the links out next day. More internal communication would be nice.

Responsiveness was good and polite, as was the negotiating process. However, the description of the item from the sales representative was inaccurate. I was told the dials on the front were a different colour (black) to what they actually were (blue and grey). I was also told that the watch was in excellent condition but when it arrived, the strap was very worn. I did raise this with Watchfinder arguing that a watch should not be described as 'in excellent condition' if the strap needs replacing. Very disappointingly they were unwilling to cover the cost of a replacement strap and argued that the website pictures were an accurate reflection of the watch condition. All-in-all a pretty mediocre experience.

Good selection of watches, quite over-priced and difficult to negotiate. Not the best when selling watches to them, regardless of how many sold, they cant pay until 5 days after buying. Not a massive problem, but frustrating when selling expensive products over lots of repeat orders

For me, purchasing a time piece is a very emotional, personal and potentially nervous time in a young mans life. Especially if it's his first Rolex that is about to cost 12k.I got a very cold experience with very little knowledge on the watch and mainly via email. They did give me a little discount which was very small, but appreciated. I just feel it could of been a lot more special as it was a really exciting time. So much so I was very close to not buying it at all from watch finder. It was only the other supplier has sold the one I wanted.If you want a good watch at about market rate and the peace of mind it's genuine etc, watchfinder is for you. I would strongly recommend buying in store than online. Not personal at all, very little knowledge on the watch.
The wait of 1 week or so is far too long for a part exchange. At most, it should only be 3 days - this is my honest and sincere feedback!

After repeatedly asking for the watch to be delivered on a Monday it arrived on the Saturday before when I wasn't going to be there which caused me a few issues.Asked for the strap to be adjusted which wasn't and I've just had to pay a jewellers to amend it, other than that it's a nice watch.

Pleased with the watch itself and the email responses I received whilst purchasing the watch.However, I was promised that the watch would be dispatched the following Friday and I would receive it Saturday. This was not the case as watchfinder did not purchase the Saturday delivery that I was promised. A little disappointing as I was promised it on the Saturday.

The buying experience itself was excellent - sales guy Michael Bergin was amazing, really friendly, very informative and the whole purchasing process was easy and straight forward and best of all secure. Sadly I found dealing with the dispatch team a little frustrating, i had to chase them twice over two days to secure the delivery of my watch and genuinely felt like i was an inconvenience to them - I felt there was a slight "we have your money now so we really are'nt that bothered" attitude that I felt was a big let down.Whilst I love the watch I bought which exceeded all my expectations it was delivered with no certificate of authenticity or warranty card - I've since chased this and they will be forwarded to me separately.Overall whilst I'm happy with my purchase I feel the start to finish process of buying & receiving a watch through Watchfinder and the experience of dealing with different departments could be improved, that being said I wouldn't rule out buying through them again.
The person who served me did not really looked very enthusiastic. He took his time to get the watch and I had to ask for the box and paper. Not very impressed!

The product was exactly as described and the communication was very good, untill the payment was made. As soon as I had entered my credit card details though, I felt a bit left alone and did not get an answer to my email from the responsible person anymore, which I had close contact with before. The shipping was rather quick.
Nice watch but a couple of niggles - had asked for strap to be reduced in size but didn't happen.

Watchfinder's customer service was good, as always, but disappointed in the product. The watch was not in the advertised condition, with dents in the bezel that were not evident in the marketing photo. After several good experiences with WF, this was a let down.

2 parts to this review. Excellent watch, online and post sale service. However...really disappointing service in the Leeds store, the member of staff had very little knowledge, I had to tell him how to adjust a Tag watch strap and explain why the strap had broken on the Omega I was buying was because a screw was missing, he disagreed and tried to reassemble before agreeing it needed to be sent back, not to mention the fact that the watch hadn't been correctly put back together after its service. Didn't put me or my mrs off our watches but certainly took the shine off the experience.

I had been looking to sell 2 of my watches for a little while, waiting till I was offered a price I was happy with, I ended up sending one to Watch finder as their top value was £50 higher than the other offer, the other watch was sold to a jeweller for £200 more, but thought the £50 would cover the postage! The watches were sent off and received the next working day, the guy form the other jewellers had the watch checked over and the payment issued the same day he received it! Watchfinder have taken in inordinate amount of time to "Test" the watch, and have informed we that it will be another 5 working days now for the payment to be received. That is 16 days from postage, and once the watch was "tested" they offered me the same price at the other place! I have phoned 4 times to chase up the progress of this watch and although the staff have been helpful they have been rather blunt and unfriendly on the phone. No one has done anything wrong as such it just feels difficult and unnecessarily lengthy. I wish I'd sent them both to the first place now.

i arrived at the shop and i was told to wait for someone to serve me, i was waiting patiently, another guy came in 20 years my senior fully suited and booted, and the lady came over and started dealing with him within moments.I was wearing jeans and sneakers.The lady asked me if i am ok as i obviously didnt look too impressed. i said no i am waiting to be served. i was told to wait, so she asked another guy to come help me..eventually i was served and the guy was great....but it felt pretty clear...lets serve the old rich looking guy in braces, not the young guy in sneakers...even though hes been waiting and the old guy just turned up........anyway i bought the watch very happy, hilariously the old man didnt buy anything..i hope you work on commission as thats the karma for that lady poorly picking her battles......in any other situation i probably would have just walked out if im honest, but the guy i spoke to was really good at his job, and also i didnt have the luxury of time to get my gf a birthday present.....that did make me think twice about my future watchfinder purchases....i felt like oprah in that handbag shop...but really....uncool....so advice...just cause I didnt have a suit and braces....doesnt mean that i dont have money.
Beautiful watches and Scott was great but there just weren't enough staff in the store to help out so 3 stars for lack of customer service.

Very good part X price given on my watch.Was a little surprised at the Burlington Arcade store. Picked up my watch sat on a sofa with 3 other chaps. A little more privacy would of been nice especially when picking up a 30 watch. The watch was unworn but on further inspection I noted 2 scratches around the bracelet bar and the lug. I guess this is where they remove bracelet to check codes etc. I polish this out at a later service. The dealing through the internet and email was superb but think a little more effort into the personal experience would go a long way.

Sent a request to service an Omega watch (purchased from watchfinder) using the online enquiry form. Received an auto response immediately stating they would be in touch - haven't heard anything in the 3 days since.Updated my review to 3 stars as WF did respond and provide a quote after posting this review

I was able to negociate a price and had the watch delivered to the Leeds branch. I was told twice that the branch will call me to tell me when it's ready to collect. But nothing happened. I had to call them twice instead to get my watch and the appointment for it.

Watch its self is perfect and I couldn't have expected it to be in better condition. Customer service however wasn't what I would expect, I had no conformation of purchase email come through until the following day, I then confirmed via email delivery date and waited in, when the watch didn't arrive I emailed again and felt like I had some attitude from customer service who hadn't received my email, I forward it with the date and got an apology and the watch was sent the next day. As communication wasn't good I hadn't thought twice about not having a conformation back and I had to be the one to email and check I wasn't waiting in for no reason (which it turns out I was)

Used these guys for buying and selling but felt the need to caveat my previous good experiences with a friendly warning to buyers.. Bought a 1967 Rolex Datejust online, transaction smooth, watch arrived at my chosen sore for collection.  Simple check by me highlighted the serial number didn't match the paperwork year, they were 11 years different.  Staff member was disinterested in my concern and she just said "we can only sell them as we buy them and if the paperwork says 1967, that's how we sell it".  this despite the fact a simple check by me showed it to be 1978.  I was concerned that checks were not made of this nature and the staff member was unconcerned.  Asked for a refund and after over a week it still hasn't arrived.  Called them and told that the refund needed authorisation and this delayed the processing of it for 5 days.  So, in summary, they have some great pieces, service is usually great but beware, look beyond this and don't be afraid to question them.

I was very happy with my watch and the help given to me when buying over the telephone, and thats my problem. The number I called on was a non geographic number which I was unaware of at the time. My purchase cost me £15 on my 'phone bill!  However, delivery was free and prompt the next day.
Hi there, watchfinder is a big watch butique wih a great selection of watch👍🏻🙏🏻. However, the knowledge of the sales is not well enough to represent the botique.

Purchased an Oris Williams day date on Dec 16. Within a month it was not holding its power reserve and I had to do a return and repair under warranty. This was reasonably straight forward apart from numerous people needing to log the issue then one to arrange the return box to be delivered..Overall I wonder if the watch was actually serviced/ checked before purchase. I think not.

All previous purchases from Watchfinder have been in top condition, my latest watch had a destinctley pre-worn appearance . Back of the watch was dirty an marked. I was disappointed and watch was not to usual standard of presentation.

Service good , easy to contact, when watch came Rolex box had one of the points of the crown missing, was a 21st present and my son noticed it straight away, took the shine off it unfortunately, and nothing mentioned on site about the damage .

I was disappointed to find that a watch sold as being with papers only had a single plastic card with it. Clearly price reflects the completeness of the whole package and papers provide provenance.  I accepted the watch and having queried the whereabouts of the papers was told that if I needed the manual then I could download it from the internet - I did so -  it was an annual calendar watch and instructions on setting and using the watch were vital.  The same applied to a copy of the manufacturer's guarantee.

All in all, a good transaction. One small detail was missed . No information on the additional linkage for the bracelet of the watch I bought. This could be added to the advertisement. The watch I traded had everything from new, including the linkage that was removed from new to reflect my wrist size. This was not included in the one I bought, and no mention of this in the advertisement or communication from Watch finder

Despite booking an appointment, I had to wait around to been seen. Once seen they didn't know how to operate the watch. They had to disappear out the babmck of the shop to get help... again kept me waiting for over 15mins.Once I was happy with the watch, it took a further 10mins to change a pin in the strap.Overall, not experience that I wanted when purchasing an item of high value

The sale service was fine. It was the delivery service from Royal Mail that was less than satisfactory.We have a longish drive and by the electric entrance  gates there is a wooden letter box . I was waiting for the call from the delivery driver and decided to check on your tracking system when I might expect the parcel .The web site said that it had arrived. It turned out that the delivery driver had just dumped it in the box and signed for it himself.It could easily have been stolen. I have written to you but not received a reply

My initial experience was not great, with the staff in the shop being quite stand-off-ish, but latterly that has improved and there are more smiles evident.I decided to have my watch serviced, but you cannot just drop it off in store, you have to go online and get a quote first (not clever) and then I was able to take it in - although even that didn't cut the time down significantly.The email updates were SUPER helpful and polite; very much appreciated.The pick up, again in store, was painless although I have a minor gripe around business' refusal to accept Amex.All in, I will be going back (hopefully with enough money to buy one of their beautiful watch stock), but I hope they take constructive feedback on board...
Dealing with the watch finder was so easy and simple, the guy who helped me Kevin was great and very good communication with me! Once again thanks

Generally the service is polite and respectful but the team I worked with took far too long to process what was a very straightforward swap and purchase. I understand the need for showing ID at the beginning but when I went to collect the watch and was asked again for ID by the lady I sat with for half an hour the day before ( I did not have it with me as everything paid for and agreed ) it became really frustrating and I came close to walking out the door. The process takes far too long and you can see the staff procrastinating BUT compared to other organisations in the market watchfinder is still one of the best second hand watch markets to trade with.

I found the Rolex on the watchfinder website, I spoke to Tom Holland who said he would arrange for the watch to be sent to the bluewater store for the weekend. However, when I called the bluewater store to check if it had arrived he had not sent it as another buyer had requested to look at the watch the following week so he decided to send it to the mayfair store without telling me! Therefore if I hadn't of called beforehand I would have got all the way there and it wouldn't have been there as agreed so I wasn't happy about this. However, I spoke to Georgia at the bluewater store who was very nice and very helpful and sorted it out for me and managed to get the watch sent straight over to bluewater for me to look at the following day, she also got another similar Rolex for me to look at as well. I was kept updated by email when the watch had arrived. The watch was in perfect condition and I was very happy with it, it came with the box and I also received a letter of authenticity in the post, however the man I was served by was rude and answered any question I had with yes or no he was very abrupt. I was hoping the lady that I had dealt with on the phone was going to be there but unfortunately she wasn't. I would still recommend buying from this store and would have rated 5 stars if I had only dealt with Georgia. Thank you

General Email updates/notifications goodLeeds facility good, especially the opening timesTrade in process worked well overall but the process wasn't clearly explainedTransaction took 9 days in total to complete from initial contact to delivery of watch which is too long

I confirmed that I wanted to proceed with a purchase and paid for it according. 2 hours later I received a phone call to inform me that someone had beaten me to the purchase. As you can imagine I was not impressed. The watchfinder system does not take the watch off sale once the order has been sent to the customer for payment, a glitch that I feel must be rectified immediately. I then received a second phone call informing me that David could redeem himself by locating me an identical watch and that it would be with watchfinder within a week and true to his word he came up with the goods 3 days later and for a pre owned and unworn version of this particular piece proves they have the connections to help.

I’m sure that, if you’re buying from Watchfinder, you’ll largely get a good pre-owned watch and have very few problems. My own experience suggests that you won’t have the same level of service you’d get if buying a new watch from one of the reputable high street shops: Watches of Switzerland in particular. Maybe if I’d visited Watchfinder personally rather than using their 'click and collect‘ things would’ve been different but I did pick up at their Burlington Arcade office and sort of expected a more comfortable setting to collect several grand’s worth of timepiece (a coffee would’ve been nice).I would also have liked a swifter response to my post-purchase communications. I felt I had to chase.Still, when picking up the watch, the service was polite and efficient but didn’t compare well with a further watch purchase later the same day at Watches of Switzerland on Regent St where we couldn’t move for people offering us prosecco and had a guided tour around the various high end departments. Pretty special.

Ordered two watches and all seemed to be going well until Royal Mail got involved.  Watches didn't arrive when promised (and still haven't) and no ability to track the order.  Need to use a better courier/delivery company.

I come through London on business, so my biggest issue is partially due to not being resident in London.The issues...1) The process of trading in a watch here requires the watch being sent to Watchfinder in advance.  It is effectively a multi-day process, which is very inefficient and problematic for someone lacking several days in London, or who may not want to spend the money or go through the hassle of sending the watch by courier in advance.  I would rather live with some ambiguity about trade-in value for a couple days in exchange for the convenience of a single visit and transaction.  There must be a way!2)  It is very much "Buyer Beware" here.  Unlike other dealers, Watchfinder does not give a detailed condition report online, which puts the burden of selection in advance on the buyer.  Fine, but how to narrow a selection down?  For example, say I'm interested in a Rolex Submariner.  There are dozens available over Watchfinder's 4-5 locations.  How is one to narrow it down to 3-4 watches to view without knowing much about the condition of any of them?  Then those watches need to be sent to a single location for viewing, by arrangement.  Fingers crossed it all works out for the allotted day and time.3) Related point...  unexpected scratches and other imperfections are often found when actually inspecting a watch (bring a Loup!) which can lead to a wasted visit.  Condition reports could reduce or eliminate wasted visits. I know I need a clean bezel, but I can live with scratches on the case.  Simple things like this.4) Lastly, the sales staff on hand has varying degrees of industry and brand knowledge.  Don't go there for advice.The combination of all these points means that successfully conducting a trade-in and purchase with Watchfinder may be less likely or more complicated than with other dealers.Aside from and despite these points, the Watchfinder team was friendly and worked hard to handle my partial trade-in fairly.  It took several weeks, dozens of emails, and two trips to London, but the end result was satisfactory.  I got the watch I wanted, in (almost) the condition I hoped for, at a reasonable price.  The trade-in value on my watch was also fair.Another complimentary point:  Watchfinder deals in a wider variety and range of watches than many other 2nd hand dealers.I will do business with them again, certainly for certain brands, and am now more aware of the logistics involved in partial trade-ins.
